tags: how to potty train a puppy
script: Potty training a puppy comes down to a routine and a lot of praise. Puppies have small bladders and little control, so you need to give them frequent chances to get it right. Take your puppy outside first thing in the morning, after every meal, after naps, after play, and before bed, and about every one to two hours in between. Use the same spot and the same word, like go potty, so they learn what the trip is for. The moment they finish, praise them and give a small treat right there, not after you come back inside. Watch for signals like sniffing, circling, or heading to the door. If you see them, go straight outside. Accidents will happen, and punishing your puppy only teaches them to hide. Clean the spot with an enzyme cleaner so the smell does not invite a repeat. Keep your puppy supervised indoors, and use a crate or a gated area when you cannot watch them. Most puppies need weeks to get reliable, so stay consistent and celebrate every success.
